subject: planner: fix max-one-row will hash equals to each other because of no elements inside. (#57797)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent (planner scope only). The change adjusts Hash64/Equals behavior for `LogicalMaxOneRow` (and adds generated support for `LogicalSequence`) by tagging `BaseLogicalPlan` for hash64-equals and making the generated methods incorporate `BaseLogicalPlan` (plan ID) into the digest/equality; `BaseLogicalPlan.Hash64/Equals` assertions are relaxed only for these operator types. This prevents “empty-attribute” logical ops from all hashing/equating to each other. Checked surrounding cascades memo usage (`GroupExpression.Hash64` mixes operator hash + child groups) and operator initialization paths; no plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/session/txn behavior. Later `upstream/master` history touching these files shows no follow-up fix/revert suggesting a hidden Blocker/High regression here.
